jobs.title: SHKler als Projektleiter (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die steigenden Energiekosten treffen jeden Haushalt. Wir senken, was gerade am meisten wehtut.

Enter ist die Antwort auf eine Frage, die sich gerade Millionen Hausbesitzer stellen: Nicht ob ihr Haus elektrifiziert wird – sondern wie, und mit wem. Bei steigenden Energiekosten helfen wir Haushalten durch die Installation der richtigen Wärmepumpen und PV-Anlagen jährlich bis zu 2.900€ einzusparen.

Als Deutschlands führender Energieberater mit über 40 Millionen Euro Funding und über 90 Mitarbeitern sind wir erfahrene Pioniere in einem Markt, der gerade erst so richtig losgeht.

Enter. Jetzt ist der Moment.

Die Fakten.

Du kennst Wärmepumpen aus der Praxis und willst nicht mehr jeden Morgen um 6 auf die Baustelle? Dann bring dein Wissen ins Büro und sorge dafür, dass unsere Anlagen richtig geplant und gebaut werden.

  • Fixgehalt: 60.000 - 70.000 € pro Jahr
  • Arbeitsort: Büro an der Spree (Schlesische Str. 26, 10997 Berlin)
  • Homeoffice Möglichkeiten
  • Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/w) und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Benefits: Learning-Budget, Urban Sports Clubs, Jobticket- oder Kita-Zuschuss; Betriebliche Alt

Stahlbau | Technisches Projektgeschäft | Internationalisierung

Region Dresden / Südbrandenburg | Vertrauliches Suchmandat

  • Ausbau nationaler und internationaler Kundenbeziehungen

About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

jobs.description:
About us

Every large industrial company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made.

STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data.

STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup, profitable and majority founder-owned with our Series A still ahead of us, funded by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by 15 global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy.

I started Anima to change that.

Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima.

We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions.

Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them.
